# Nesronix Community — Open Technology For Everyone

> Nesronix Community (nesronix.org) is an open technology movement, AI research group, cybersecurity laboratory, and technical academy founded by Mohamed Shaban Ibrahim (M. Salatmani). We build open-source frameworks, conduct artificial intelligence research, and foster developer talent.

## Organization & Leadership
- **Organization Name**: Nesronix Community
- **Official Domain**: https://nesronix.org/
- **Founder & Lead Architect**: Mohamed Shaban Ibrahim (M. S alatmani)
- **Founder Profile & Personal Sites**: https://nesronix.org/founder | https://msalatmani.org/ | https://moshaban.me/
- **Corporate Sister Agency**: NESRONIX LLC (https://nesronix.com/ | https://ceo.nesronix.com/)
- **Core Focus**: Open Source Software, AI Research, Cyber Systems Security, Technical Education, Edge Robotics.

## Key Divisions & Platforms

### 1. Open Source Frameworks & Projects
- Developer tools, AI libraries, and security research tools hosted on GitHub.
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/nesronix
- Founder GitHub: https://github.com/m0shaban

### 2. Nesronix AI & Security Labs
- Applied research in local SLMs, hybrid RAG architectures, edge vision algorithms, and penetration testing.

### 3. Nesronix Academy & Education
- Community workshops, technical masterclasses, and hands-on developer training.
